title: Finite double dual preserves a finite locally free restriction
statement:
theorem affine_double_dual_restriction
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) [Module.Finite A M]
    (P : W.toScheme.Modules) [P.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (e : Modules.restrict (tilde M) W.ι ≅ P) :
    Nonempty (Modules.restrict
      (tilde (ModuleCat.of A (Module.Dual A (Module.Dual A M)))) W.ι ≅ P)

proof.text: Both M and its first dual are finitely presented by Noetherianity. On each basic affine open inside W apply localization-Hom twice. The resulting canonical comparisons identify the restriction of the actual double-dual associated sheaf with the sheaf double dual of the restriction of tilde M.

Transport the given restriction isomorphism to P through the two dual functors. Evaluation to the double dual is an isomorphism for a finite locally free module, checked on finite free trivializations. The canonical comparisons commute with restriction, and hence glue on overlaps to the desired isomorphism. This has no depth hypothesis or conclusion.
